name: timer_start
description: Start a focus timer. Up to 5 run at once, each with its own name; they show as pills above the screens and each rings when its time is up. Give it a name when the user says what it's for ('tea', 'standup'). Then say in a few words what you set.

minutes.description: length in minutes (0.5 = 30 seconds, 90 = an hour and a half)

label.description: what it's for, if the user said (e.g. 'tea'); default Focus

name: timer_control
description: Change a timer. pause / resume; add: `minutes` more (negative takes time off; on a timer that already rang it runs again for that long); stop: cancels it AND turns off its ring, so use it for 'turn it off', 'stop the timer', 'I'm done'. `timer` is its name (or 'all'); leave it out when there's only one it can mean (stop without one turns off whichever are ringing).

name: timer_status
description: Every timer: its name, how much time is left, and whether it's running, paused or ringing.

name: notes_add
description: Write something down in the user's notes, one note per call; the notes panel opens to show it. Keep the user's words, minus filler.

name: notes_list
description: The user's notes, newest first (id, text, done). Use it to read them back or to find one to change.

name: notes_edit
description: Change one note: check it off (done=true), un-check it (done=false) or rewrite its text.

note.description: the note's id, or a few words of its text

name: notes_remove
description: Remove one note. It can be brought back: undo=true restores the last note removed.

note.description: the note's id, or a few words of its text

undo.description: true = bring back the last removed note instead

name: notes_view
description: Show or hide the notes panel: open ('pull up my notes'), minimized (it shrinks into a small dot the user can move and tap to open again), closed.
